mapper.select: select id, packet_no, sponsor_id, total_amount, total_count, remain_amount, remain_count, packet_type, status, create_time, update_time from red_packet where packet_no = #{packetNo}
mapper.insert: insert into red_packet (packet_no, sponsor_id, total_amount, total_count, remain_amount, remain_count, packet_type, status) values (#{packetNo}, #{sponsorId}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{remainAmount}, #{remainCount}, #{packetType}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, packet_no, user_id, amount, create_time from red_packet_record where packet_no = #{packetNo} order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into red_packet_record (packet_no, user_id, amount) values (#{packetNo}, #{userId}, #{amount})
